title: Ansel and the Cellar
author: Beatrix Delacroix
blurb: Oscar Galloway, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
